# Create core implementation library
add_library(cfd_core_impl STATIC)
target_sources(cfd_core_impl PRIVATE 
    ${CORE_HEADERS}
    ${CORE_SOURCES}
)

find_package(Eigen3 CONFIG REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(cfd_core_impl 
	PRIVATE 
		Eigen3::Eigen
)


# Include directories

    PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    PRIVATE
        ${CORE_SRC_DIR}
)

# Compiler features
target_compile_features(cfd_core_impl PUBLIC cxx_std_23)

# Source groups for IDE
